segments.text: This is Cascade, built on the Buffer API.
If you post on X, LinkedIn and Instagram, you know each one wants the same idea told differently. Short on X, the full story on LinkedIn, a caption on Instagram.
So you either paste the same text everywhere, or rewrite it by hand every day. That's the part Cascade does for you.
With Cascade, a founder can announce a launch everywhere in a minute. A small business can share today's offer on every channel. A creator can promote a new video without rewriting it five times.
Here's how it works. I sign in with Buffer, and my channels load right away.
I write my idea once, in my own words, and add an image.
I pick my channels, and Cascade writes a version for each one.
X gets a short post. LinkedIn gets the full story. Both stay within Buffer's limits, and nothing is added that I didn't write.
I can edit any post, then choose to queue it, schedule it, or save it as a draft.
One tap sends everything to Buffer, and saves my original idea in Buffer Ideas.
That's Cascade. Write once, and every network gets a post that fits. Try it at oncascade dot vercel dot app.
